_what: Held-out Indonesian-voice eval. Authored fresh 2026-08-19 from Office scenarios; scored by src/score_voice.py against the rubric approved the same day. Kept OUT of data/promoted/ and out of every training corpus.

threshold._verified: 38/40 passes and 37/40 fails, checked against the scorer.

gating._why: Per-dimension rates say WHERE a regression happened; a single number cannot.

_domains_disjoint_from.survey_corpus: banking and civil administration (blocking cards, OTP, Dukcapil, NPWP)
_domains_disjoint_from.training_corpus: procurement, access review, staff training programmes

_analysis.exact_reuse: 0 against all four corpora — no answer, user phrasing, or item is reused.
_analysis.token_overlap_is_not_reuse: Up to 0.90 against the promoted corpus, but that is shared common Indonesian vocabulary (berikut, bagian, dokumen, untuk, tidak), not shared content. Reported because the raw number looks alarming and would otherwise invite a wrong conclusion.
_analysis.phrase_overlap_8gram_full_prompt: 6/40 items — ALL instruction templates or document-format boilerplate ('terjemahkan teks berikut ke bahasa inggris pertahankan angka', 'memo internal kepada seluruh kepala bagian'). This sharing is DELIBERATE: the eval must use the product's real task instructions or it is not testing the product's tasks.
_analysis.phrase_overlap_8gram_content_only: 1/40 — the memo header layout only. No scenario, fact, figure, or answer is shared with any training or survey corpus.

_leakage_note: tantular_sft_aug.jsonl IS the 153-example corpus that trained tantular:0.2-id-3b-lora, and tantular_sft.jsonl its 17-example seed. Neither answer, user phrasing, nor paraphrase is reused here. Token overlap is common Indonesian vocabulary, not shared content — exact reuse is 0 against all four.

rubric.register: no informal address (Kak/kamu/lo), no greeting filler opening a document answer
rubric.terminology: generic anglicisms flagged where a standard term exists; established domain terms allow-listed; source-required terms exempt
rubric.language: Indonesian-dominant, except where the task asks for English

_no_model_judges_another: Every check is a deterministic string or ratio test.
